environment.description: Same ASP.NET Core 8.0 application deployed inside a gVisor (runsc) container with a custom OCI runtime spec. The container's rootfs is assembled via a distroless base image (gcr.io/distroless/dotnet8-debian12) with an additional pivot_root into /app/sandbox at container init. The OCI spec sets 'root.path' to '/app/sandbox' and 'process.noNewPrivileges=true'. A seccomp profile (based on the default Docker profile) is applied with additional restrictions: the 'execve', 'execveat', 'fork', 'vfork', and 'clone' (with CLONE_THREAD flag only permitted) syscalls are filtered to SCMP_ACT_ERRNO. The mount namespace contains only the application binary, its deps, the dotnet runtime, and an empty writable tmpfs at /app/sandbox/workflow_states. /proc is mounted read-only with hidepid=2. /dev contains only /dev/null, /dev/zero, /dev/urandom. No shell binaries, no curl/wget, no Python/Perl interpreters exist in the image. Network egress is restricted by a Cilium NetworkPolicy allowing only TCP port 443 to the internal service mesh endpoints (10.0.0.0/8). The gVisor sentry intercepts all syscalls, meaning even if BinaryFormatter deserializes a gadget chain that attempts Process.Start or file operations outside the sandbox root, the kernel-level enforcement prevents execution of arbitrary binaries and limits blast radius to the empty sandbox directory.

config.runtime: gVisor runsc with custom OCI spec
config.seccomp_profile: custom: execve=ERRNO, execveat=ERRNO, fork=ERRNO, vfork=ERRNO, clone=ERRNO(except CLONE_THREAD)
config.filesystem_contents: dotnet runtime, app binary, empty tmpfs at workflow_states only
config.network_egress: Cilium policy: allow TCP/443 to 10.0.0.0/8 only
